decision.interpretation: Frozen descriptive research gate; no general size guarantee or automatic default

uncertainty: Unadjusted exact 95% binomial intervals for tiny independent cells; descriptive, not simultaneous
limitations: Cached-score arms hold training-view transforms fixed; they are not full-pipeline calibration.
BIC costs are compared within each score space; absolute BIC across dimensions is not ranked.
Native versus common-order head contrasts may differ through optimization row order.
Controls/conflicting laws have no privileged four-species truth.
In-sample linear recovery can saturate in high dimension; it is not a biological information bound.
Four fresh datasets per cell support only a bounded descriptive decision.
